id.description: Permanent, globally unique provider identifier. Must remain constant across restarts and reconnects – derived from hardware serial number, MAC address, or equivalent immutable source.

category.description: Provider category. HARDWARE for physical devices (incl. adapters), VIRTUAL_INTERNAL for built-in virtual sources, VIRTUAL_SCRIPT for script-based virtual sources.

persistConfig.description: If true, the provider persists configuration (alias, color overrides) autonomously. This means the device behaves identically across different E-Lab instances. If false (default), the E-Lab dispatcher stores configuration in its SQLite DB on behalf of the provider.

id.description: Permanent, unique task identifier. Must remain constant across restarts – like a hardware serial number or MAC-derived value. Used by E-Lab to track configuration (alias, color) persistently.

groupId.description: Groups tasks within a provider into a functional unit. The hardware supports only one task of a group at a time.

color.description: Default hex color for this task (e.g. #ef4444). Acts as the initial visualization color for SENSOR, MATH, MEASURE, CONTROL, and GENERATOR tasks. Can be overridden at runtime by the user at source or sink level. Color changes at a sink propagate back to the nearest upstream source (but not beyond intermediate processing modules like MATH).

tags.description: Freeform tags for filtering in the UI (e.g. multimeter, temperature, usb).

group.description: Task group for exclusivity. Tasks in the same group can be dispatched in parallel; tasks in different groups are mutually exclusive per provider.

actions.description: Declarative list of special commands that the task provider supports. The UI renders action buttons only for declared actions.

id.description: The command action string sent via cmd_control (e.g. START_RAW).

icon.description: Lucide icon name to display in the UI.

config.$comment: Task runtime configuration. Any model-level uncertainty should be declared in config.accuracy so UI and MATH tasks can propagate uncertainty consistently.

factor.description: Multiplication factor to convert from unit to siUnit.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate in samples per second. Describes the resolution of a SENSOR stream.

accuracy.description: Structured measurement uncertainty model. Set to null to disable uncertainty metadata for this task.
accuracy.$comment: Server uses this object to derive payload uncertainty in decoded units. Prefer explicit models over a single percent number.

accepts.description: Optional input capability hint for ACTUATOR tasks. Use values like scalar, array, values, stream to declare supported command payload shapes.

maxRateHz.description: Optional upper bound for command delivery rate to this task (commands per second).

key.description: The property key under which the value is stored and sent.

label.description: Display name of the configuration element.

type.description: UI element type: number, slider, select, toggle, datetime, text, button.

value.description: Current value used to initialize the UI.

min.description: Minimum value (relevant for number and slider).

max.description: Maximum value (relevant for number and slider).

step.description: Step size (relevant for number and slider).

unit.description: Unit label (for example Hz) displayed next to the field.

default.description: Default value used when current value is missing.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for text input fields.

buttonText.description: Label for button fields. Clicking triggers update_config with action=key.

options.description: Choices for type=select. Each element contains label and value.

decoder.$comment: Decoder converts transport/binary payload to engineering units. If linearizationTable is present, uncertainty transformation should use local derivative (segment slope), not a global range ratio.

linearizationTable.$comment: Piecewise-linear transfer table [x_raw_scaled, y_engineering]. For uncertainty mapping, use local dy/dx from the active segment.

integrity.description: Optional Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash for the remote plugin script.

apiVersion.description: API version expected by the remote plugin.

accuracyObject.$comment: Model library for uncertainty. Systematic terms are absolute bounds. Random terms are 1-sigma. MATH mean filters should reduce randomSigma by sqrt(n) while keeping systematicAbs unchanged.

model.$comment: Use 'combined' to compose nested systematic/random models. Use 'percent_reading_plus_digits' for DMM-like specs.

relativePctReading.$comment: Relative contribution in percent of |measured value|.

digits.$comment: Count of display digits in a '% reading + digits' model.

digitReference.$comment: ESP32/ADC note: adc_lsb may differ from UI least-significant digit. Choose explicitly.

displayStep.$comment: Absolute step size of UI LSD when digitReference == ui_lsd.

digitStep.$comment: Explicit absolute step size when digitReference == explicit_step.

randomSigma.$comment: Random uncertainty as 1-sigma in measurement unit.

confidenceK.$comment: Coverage factor for display bounds (for example k=2).
